title: 第108章：我凭什么听你的？
slug: 流放路上捡破烂两岁萌娃养肥全家
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

女人的声音，从营帐外传来。

张强眉头一拧，警惕地看向帐帘的方向，“谁在外面？”

他的话刚落下，帐帘被人掀开。

秦昭岚手持匕首，飞快地冲进来。

张强的反应很快，迅速躲开了。

看见突然出现的秦昭岚，他的眉头皱得更紧了。

“怎么是你？”张强转头看向大力，“你带她来的？”

大力闻言，忙不迭地摇头，“不是我带她来的，肯定是她自己跟来的！”

“没有我和将军的允许，你私自离开北荒地，是要受军法处置的！”

“废话真多！”秦昭岚手持匕首，指向张强，“信上写了什么？”

“什么信？”张强皱眉。

秦昭岚冷哼：“别装了！你扣下别人写给我的信，不仅看了里面的内容，还将信烧了。不知张副将的所作所为，萧将军知道吗？”

时间过去太久，张强刚才的确是忘了。

经秦昭岚一提醒，他这才想起一个多月前，他的确收到一封写给秦昭岚的信。

只是这件事情，知道的人只有他和大力，这个女人是怎么知道的？

想着，张强转头看向大力，目光里带着审视。

大力对上他的眼眸，知道他是在怀疑自己，连忙摆了摆手。

“副将，不是我说的。”

“这件事情只有你我二人知道。不是你说的，告诉我还有谁？”

张副将咬牙，认定了是大力将事情说出去的。

大力张了张嘴想解释。

可话到了嘴边，又被他咽了回去。

之前他跟兄弟们喝酒，喝醉后不小心将此事说了出来。

这话的确是从他这里传出去的，可他没想到，那群兄弟之中，会有人背叛他！

“我没功夫陪你们在这里讨论，是谁把事情传出去的。告诉我信上的内容，否则我……”

“怎么，想威胁我？你也不看看，这里是谁的地盘？”张副将打断秦昭岚的话，看向大力，“愣着做什么，还不赶紧把她拿下！”

大力颔首，快步上前。

秦昭岚从腰间掏出枪，指着大力。

大力看见手枪，忽而感觉手臂又开始痛了。

他下意识地抬起双手，做投降状。

“这里是军营，你别……别乱来！”

大力咽了咽唾沫，紧张地看向秦昭岚。

秦昭岚拿着枪往张强的方向一指，“不想死就站过去！”

Page (1/3)

A woman's voice came from outside the camp.

Zhang Qiang frowned and looked in the direction of the curtain warily, "Who is outside?"

As soon as he finished speaking, the curtain was opened.

Qin Zhaolan rushed in quickly with a dagger in hand.

Zhang Qiang reacted quickly and quickly dodged.

Seeing Qin Zhaolan suddenly appearing, his brows furrowed even more.

"Why is it you?" Zhang Qiang turned to look at Dali, "Did you bring her here?"

Hearing this, Dali shook his head hastily, "I didn't bring her here, she must have followed her!"

"If you leave the Northern Wasteland without permission from me and the general, you will be subject to military law!"

"So much nonsense!" Qin Zhaolan pointed at Zhang Qiang with a dagger in his hand, "What was written in the letter?"

"What letter?" Zhang Qiang frowned.

Qin Zhaolan snorted: "Stop pretending! You took the letter written by someone else and not only read the content inside, but also burned the letter. I don't know what Vice General Zhang did. Does General Xiao know about it?"

Time passed so long that Zhang Qiang had indeed forgotten just now.

After Qin Zhaolan reminded him, he remembered that he had indeed received a letter addressed to Qin Zhaolan more than a month ago.

It's just that the only people who knew about this matter were him and Dali. How did this woman know about it?

Thinking about it, Zhang Qiang turned to look at Dali with scrutiny in his eyes.

Dali met his eyes and knew that he was doubting himself, so he waved his hand quickly.

"Lieutenant, I didn't say that."

"Only you and I know about this matter. It's not you who said it. Tell me who else?"

Vice General Zhang gritted his teeth and decided that it was Dali who told the story.

Dali opened his mouth to explain.

But when the words came to his lips, he swallowed them back.

He had been drinking with his brothers before, and accidentally revealed the matter when he was drunk.

These words indeed came from him, but he didn't expect that some of those brothers would betray him!

"I don't have time to discuss with you here who spread the word. Tell me the content of the letter, otherwise I..."

"What, you want to threaten me? Don't you even look, whose territory is this?" Vice General Zhang interrupted Qin Zhaolan and looked at Dali, "What are you doing standing still? Why don't you take her down quickly!"

He nodded vigorously and stepped forward quickly.

Qin Zhaolan took out a gun from his waist and pointed at Dali.

When Dali saw the pistol, he suddenly felt pain in his arm again.

He subconsciously raised his hands in a gesture of surrender.

"This is a military camp, don't... don't mess around!"

Dali swallowed and looked at Qin Zhaolan nervously.

Qin Zhaolan pointed the gun in Zhang Qiang's direction, "If you don't want to die, just stand over!"
